I don’t see anything attached yet — no picture, no problem text, just your message.

What were you hoping I’d look at? You can paste the question, describe it, or share an image, and we’ll look at it together.

These look like **two group photos**, not a worksheet with printed questions.

**Photo 1:** five people in matching black hoodies (with a yellow bird logo that looks like “Behemoth”), standing in front of a colorful wall.

**Photo 2:** a bigger group around a round table full of food — like a team dinner.

Before I guess more: which photo do you mean, and what do you want to know — **who they are**, **what they’re doing**, or **what the clothes/food are**?

This new photo is a **close-up portrait** of a young man with black-rimmed glasses and a black top — like an ID or passport photo.

Looking back at your earlier group pictures: he looks like he could be **one of the five** in the matching hoodies (Photo 1).

Is your question: **“Is this the same person from Photo 1?”** — or something else (for example, his glasses / hair / clothes)?

Yes — I can see and understand the photos you’ve shared.

So far I’ve got:
1. **Five people** in matching black hoodies in front of a colorful wall  
2. **A big group dinner** around a round table  
3. **A close-up** of a young man with glasses (who may be one of the five)

What would you like to do with them — describe them in English, compare the photos, or something else?
Can you summarize this PDF file?

Ryan, this is your **end-of-year report card** from BASIS Bilingual School Shenzhen (Grade 2, Group G2.3) for 2024–2025.

**Overall:** Final score **92** — a strong year!

**Graded subjects (letter + number):**
- **Chinese 2** — Final **A / 92** (Q1–Q4: 90, 92, 89, 94)
- **Humanities 2** — Final **A / 92** (96, 90, 86, 94)
- **Math & Science 2** — Final **A / 93** (93, 93, 92, 95) — your strongest graded average

**Pass/Satisfactory subjects (mostly S):**
Dance, Mental Health, PE & Sports, Performance Arts, Technology and Design — all **S** every quarter.  
Music and Visual Arts — mostly **S**, with a **P** in Q2 (Music also P in Q3).

**Teacher comments (from the extract):**
- **Chinese:** Fluent in Chinese; works steadily and independently; participates well and shows interest.
- **Performance Arts:** Positive attitude; focuses and joins in drama with enthusiasm.

---

Would you like me to dig into **one subject** next — for example what went well in Math & Science, or what the Chinese comments mean in simpler words?
